portraits.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square head-and-shoulders pixel-art game portrait of Joffrey Baratheon, formal court attire, composed royal expression. The first two recent images are USER PHOTO REFERENCES: gold-and-black armour and crowned ceremonial purple/gold clothing. The third is the OLD PIXEL PORTRAIT, style reference only, improve its face. Preserve recognizable Joffrey identity from the photos: youthful clean-shaven face, short golden blond hair with neat fringe, straight narrow nose, pale skin, subtly aristocratic disdain. Make him distinctly MORE HANDSOME: harmonious facial proportions, elegant defined cheekbones and jaw, beautiful green eyes, poised gaze and restrained confident mouth; still youthful, not a muscular adult, no beard, no generic anime hero. His beauty should feel proud and slightly dangerous, not kind or goofy. Clothing faithful to user's ceremonial reference: fine gold patterned high-collar brocade doublet, rich deep plum-purple velvet drape over one shoulder, delicately worked GOLD ANTLER CROWN, entire crown visible with ample top margin. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, fine 16-bit RPG portrait craftsmanship, no blur or photo filter; retain texture and clarity of the old portrait. Dark desaturated teal #18282b background, upper-left soft light. Centered shoulders, head nearly frontal slight three-quarter turn, eyes toward viewer, consistent framing for a four-portrait expression set. No text, no border, no props, no extra people. 1024x1024 square.
